BiblicalUsage: Jidbash is an Israelite, a son of Etam of Judah. In 1 Chronicles 4:3, Idbash, and the name of their sister was Hazelelponi.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Idbash matters because God works through ordinary people, and no name in His book is there by accident.
